Adaboost no requiere las dummys igualque xgboost
```{r}
recipe_c50 <- recipe(realiza_domest ~ ., data = train) %>%
  update_role(ID, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_other(BHCH04_SEL, threshold = 0.2) %>%
  step_downsample(realiza_domest, under_ratio = 1)
```

```{r}
adaboost_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(),
  min_n = tune(),
  sample_size = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("C5.0") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

adaboost_spec %>% translate()
```
Agregamos el modelo al workflow
```{r}
wf_adaboost <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(recipe_c50) %>%
  add_model(adaboost_spec)
```

Folds con las mismas particiones que usamos con los otros modelos
```{r}
set.seed(123)

folds <- vfold_cv(train)
```

Tuning hiperparámetros
```{r}
set.seed(123)

tune_adaboost <- wf_adaboost %>%
  tune_grid(
    folds,
    metrics = metric_set(
      precision,
      recall,
      roc_auc,
      f_meas
    ),
    grid = 20
  )
```


Ploeto
```{r}
autoplot(tune_adaboost)
```
Obtengo métricas
```{r}
tune_adaboost %>%
  collect_metrics()
```

Elegimos el mejor según auc_roc
```{r}
best_adaboost <- select_best(
  tune_adaboost,
  metric = "roc_auc"
)

final_adaboost <- finalize_model(
  adaboost_spec,
  best_adaboost
)

final_adaboost
```

Entrenamos/fiteamos el modelo
```{r}
tree_adaboost <- wf_adaboost %>%
  update_model(final_adaboost)

fit_adaboost <- tree_adaboost %>%
  fit(train)
```
Guardo el modelo
```{r}
write_rds(
  fit_adaboost,
  "./model/adaboost_fit.RDS"
)
```

Predecimos sobre el conjunto de testeo
```{r}
adaboost_valid <- fit_adaboost %>%
  predict(test) %>%
  bind_cols(test)

adaboost_valid <- predict(
  fit_adaboost,
  test,
  type = "prob"
) %>%
  bind_cols(adaboost_valid, .)
```

```{r}
adaboost_metrics <- roc_auc(
  adaboost_valid,
  truth = realiza_domest,
  ".pred_No realiza"
) %>%
  bind_rows(
    class_metrics(
      adaboost_valid,
      truth = realiza_domest,
      estimate = .pred_class
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(modelo = "AdaBoost")
```

Comparamos modelos
```{r}
rbind(
  metrics_dt,
  metrics_bagging,
  metrics_rf,
  boost_metrics,
  adaboost_metrics
) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = .metric,
      y = .estimate,
      fill = modelo
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal()
```

Importancia de variables utilizadas (no es suuuuper interpretable pero ayuda)
```{r}
library(C50)

C5imp(fit_adaboost$fit$fit)
```

Graficamos importacia de variables de adaboost
```{r}
importance_adaboost <- C5imp(
  fit_adaboost$fit$fit
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

importance_adaboost
```
